facts.text: StartTogether releases the writers together through a Barrier so their transactions overlap, using TaskCreationOptions.LongRunning.
ReadRevisionAsync skips comments and any frame whose event name is not revision, because the stream also carries changes and reset events.
Both the count of facts with text like w%-fact-% and the distinct text count of those rows equal writers times perWriter.
Revision() must be at least before plus writers times perWriter, because every accepted fact insert fires trg_facts_insert.
The facts table count after all rounds equals rounds, so dedupe leaves a single row per round.
